name: Grow Therapy
one_liner: Free insurance credentialing in 5-7 days with 19,000+ providers nationwide, guaranteed claims, and weekly payments through revenue sharing.
short_description: Grow Therapy is a free-to-join therapist network offering fast insurance credentialing (5-7 days), guaranteed claims, weekly payments, and practice management tools.
long_description: Grow Therapy is a free-to-join therapist network available in all 50 states with over 19,000 licensed providers. Unlike subscription-based platforms, Grow Therapy operates on a revenue-sharing model—taking a percentage of insurance reimbursements with no upfront membership fees. Credentialing typically takes just 5-7 days, one of the fastest in the industry. Providers are credentialed with major payers including Aetna, Cigna, Blue Cross Blue Shield, UnitedHealthcare, Optum, Humana, Oscar, Oxford, and Anthem. Reimbursement rates range from $60-160+ per session depending on CPT code, payer, credentials, and location—with PMHNPs averaging $129/hour and LCSWs earning $85-100/session. Grow includes comprehensive practice management tools: EHR, scheduling, secure messaging, telehealth, and AI-assisted documentation, all HIPAA-compliant. Providers join as independent 1099 contractors with full clinical autonomy and flexible scheduling. Claims are guaranteed, and weekly payouts process in about seven business days after insurance pays.
best_for: Therapists wanting completely free credentialing (no membership fees)
New clinicians seeking fastest credentialing (5-7 days)
Providers wanting guaranteed claims and weekly payments
Therapists building initial caseload before transitioning to private practice
Clinicians wanting included practice management and AI documentation tools
not_for: Providers wanting full transparency on fee splits
Therapists wanting to own their insurance credentials independently
Clinicians preferring flat-fee models over revenue sharing
Those wanting highest possible reimbursement rates (consider Alma)

pricing.notes: Free to join—no membership fees. Grow Therapy retains a portion of insurance reimbursements as an administrative fee. Providers do not always receive full transparency on exact insurer-to-Grow reimbursement before payout. Claims are guaranteed.

reimbursement_rates.notes: Rates vary by CPT code, payer, credentials, and geographic location.

credentialing.note: One of the fastest in the industry

billing.payment_schedule: Weekly (7 business days after insurance pays)

faqs.q: Is Grow Therapy free for therapists?
faqs.a: Yes, Grow Therapy is completely free to join with no membership fees. The platform operates on a revenue-sharing model, taking a percentage of insurance reimbursements.

faqs.q: How fast is credentialing through Grow Therapy?
faqs.a: Grow Therapy credentials providers in 5-7 days on average—one of the fastest in the industry.

faqs.q: What are Grow Therapy reimbursement rates?
faqs.a: Rates range from $60-160+ per session depending on CPT code, payer, credentials, and location. PMHNPs average ~$129/hour while LCSWs earn $85-100/session.

faqs.q: How does Grow Therapy compare to Headway?
faqs.a: Both are free to join with revenue sharing models. Grow Therapy credentials in 5-7 days vs Headway's 2-4 weeks. Headway has a larger network (70,000+ vs 19,000+) and offers clawback protection. Both pay weekly.
